############################################# rules for species name ################################################################

number_species_labels <- function(species_vec) {

  # 1) Cleaning
  species_vec <- as.character(species_vec)
  species_vec[is.na(species_vec) | trimws(species_vec) == ""] <- "Unassigned"
  species_vec <- trimws(species_vec)

  # 2) upload phyloseq "clean" (hilu)
  frames <- sys.frames()
  hilu_ref <- NULL

  for (i in rev(seq_along(frames))) {
    if (exists("hilu", envir = frames[[i]], inherits = FALSE)) {
      hilu_ref <- get("hilu", envir = frames[[i]], inherits = FALSE)
      break
    }
  }

  # if hilu not find => use cleaned
  if (is.null(hilu_ref)) return(species_vec)

  # 3) replace Species by the "clean" one
  otu_ids <- names(species_vec)
  if (is.null(otu_ids)) return(species_vec)  # Security

  tax_ref <- as.data.frame(tax_table(hilu_ref))

  common_otus <- intersect(otu_ids, rownames(tax_ref))
  if (length(common_otus) == 0) return(species_vec)

  ref_species <- as.character(tax_ref[common_otus, "Species"])
  ref_species[is.na(ref_species) | trimws(ref_species) == ""] <- "Unassigned"
  ref_species <- trimws(ref_species)

  species_vec[common_otus] <- ref_species

  species_vec
}


################################### check host single sample and filtered sample ###################################################

process_filtered <- function(prefix, physeq_file, physeq_filtered, invasive_core, native_core) {

  # import
  hilu <- readRDS(physeq_file)
  hilu.filtered <- readRDS(physeq_filtered)

  Core_invasive <- readRDS(invasive_core)
  Core_native   <- readRDS(native_core)
  print("import success")

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # HostSpecies with n = 1
  # --------------------------------------------------
  sd <- as.data.frame(sample_data(hilu))

  host_counts <- table(sd$HostSpecies)
  lonely_hosts <- names(host_counts[host_counts == 1])
  lonely_samples <- rownames(sd)[sd$HostSpecies %in% lonely_hosts]

  if (length(lonely_samples) == 0) {
    has_lonely <- FALSE
    hilu.lonely <- NULL
    print("no lonely host -> skipping hilu.lonely")
  } else {
    hilu.lonely <- prune_samples(lonely_samples, hilu)
    has_lonely <- nsamples(hilu.lonely) > 0
    print("hilu.lonely created")
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # helper: clean names (delete unique identifiers)
  # --------------------------------------------------
  clean_final_number <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- trimws(x)
    x[x == "" | is.na(x)] <- "Unassigned"
    x
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # OTU -> Species 
  # --------------------------------------------------
  otu_to_species <- function(phy) {

    otu <- as(otu_table(phy), "matrix")
    if (!taxa_are_rows(phy)) otu <- t(otu)

    # if phy is empty => stop
    if (nrow(otu) == 0 || ncol(otu) == 0) return(NULL)

    tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))

    otu_ids <- rownames(otu)
    species_ordered <- tax[otu_ids, "Species"]

    species_ordered <- number_species_labels(species_ordered)
    tax[otu_ids, "Species"] <- species_ordered

    otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu)
    otu_df$Species <- species_ordered

    species_list <- unique(otu_df$Species)

    summed_list <- lapply(species_list, function(sp) {
      subm <- otu_df[otu_df$Species == sp, -ncol(otu_df), drop = FALSE]
      colSums(subm)
    })
    names(summed_list) <- species_list

    otu_species_mat <- do.call(rbind, summed_list)

    otu_species_mat <- as.matrix(otu_species_mat)

    if (nrow(otu_species_mat) == 0 || ncol(otu_species_mat) == 0) {
      stop(prefix, " : otu_to_species produit une matrice vide")
    }

    rownames(otu_species_mat) <- names(summed_list)

    otu_new <- otu_table(otu_species_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

    tax_species <- tax
    tax_species$..old <- rownames(tax_species)
    tax_species$Species <- as.character(tax_species$Species)

    tax_species_df <- tax_species[!duplicated(tax_species$Species), , drop = FALSE]
    rownames(tax_species_df) <- tax_species_df$Species
    tax_species_df$..old <- NULL

    # force order / same names
    tax_species_df <- tax_species_df[taxa_names(otu_new), , drop = FALSE]
    tax_new <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_species_df))

    phyloseq(otu_new, sample_data(phy), tax_new)
  }
  print("OTU to species done")

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # helper: merged taxa that became identical after clean_final_number
  # --------------------------------------------------
  collapse_by_clean_name <- function(phy) {

    if (is.null(phy)) return(NULL)

    otu <- as(otu_table(phy), "matrix")
    if (!taxa_are_rows(phy)) otu <- t(otu)

    if (nrow(otu) == 0 || ncol(otu) == 0) return(NULL)

    old_taxa <- rownames(otu)
    new_taxa <- clean_final_number(old_taxa)

    otu_collapsed <- rowsum(otu, group = new_taxa, reorder = FALSE)


    if (is.null(dim(otu_collapsed))) {
      otu_collapsed <- matrix(
        otu_collapsed,
        nrow = 1,
        dimnames = list(unique(new_taxa), colnames(otu))
      )
    } else {
      otu_collapsed <- as.matrix(otu_collapsed)
      colnames(otu_collapsed) <- colnames(otu)
    }

    otu_new <- otu_table(otu_collapsed, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

    tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))
    tax$..old <- rownames(tax)
    tax$..clean <- clean_final_number(tax$..old)

    tax_new_df <- tax[!duplicated(tax$..clean), , drop = FALSE]
    rownames(tax_new_df) <- tax_new_df$..clean
    tax_new_df$..old <- NULL
    tax_new_df$..clean <- NULL

    # align strict
    tax_new_df <- tax_new_df[taxa_names(otu_new), , drop = FALSE]
    tax_new <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_new_df))

    phyloseq(otu_new, sample_data(phy), tax_new)
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Species level + unique identifiers collapse
  # --------------------------------------------------
  hilu.filtered.species <- collapse_by_clean_name(otu_to_species(hilu.filtered))
  if (is.null(hilu.filtered.species)) stop(prefix, " : hilu.filtered donne 0 taxa ou 0 samples après transformation.")

  if (has_lonely) {
    hilu.lonely.species <- collapse_by_clean_name(otu_to_species(hilu.lonely))
  }
  print("collapsed !")

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # prepare list core
  # --------------------------------------------------
  Core_invasive_clean <- unique(clean_final_number(Core_invasive))
  Core_native_clean   <- unique(clean_final_number(Core_native))

  core_df <- rbind(
    data.frame(core = "Core_invasive", taxon = Core_invasive_clean, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    data.frame(core = "Core_native",   taxon = Core_native_clean,   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
  core_df <- core_df[!is.na(core_df$taxon) & core_df$taxon != "", , drop = FALSE]
  core_df <- core_df[!duplicated(core_df), , drop = FALSE]

  taxa_all <- unique(core_df$taxon)

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # helper: stats for host 
  # --------------------------------------------------
  host_stats <- function(phy, suffix) {

    # relative abundance
    phy_rel <- transform_sample_counts(phy, function(x) if (sum(x) == 0) x else x / sum(x))

    otu <- as(otu_table(phy_rel), "matrix")
    if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_rel)) otu <- t(otu)

    # keep only taxa of interest; if absents => row with 0
    missing_taxa <- setdiff(taxa_all, rownames(otu))
    if (length(missing_taxa) > 0) {
      add0 <- matrix(0, nrow = length(missing_taxa), ncol = ncol(otu),
                     dimnames = list(missing_taxa, colnames(otu)))
      otu <- rbind(otu, add0)
    }
    otu <- otu[taxa_all, , drop = FALSE]

    meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(phy_rel))
    hosts <- unique(meta$HostSpecies)

    out <- list()

    for (h in hosts) {
      samp <- rownames(meta)[meta$HostSpecies == h]
      subm <- otu[, samp, drop = FALSE]

      # median by taxa
      med_ab <- apply(subm, 1, median)

      # prevalence
      prev <- rowSums(subm > 0) / ncol(subm)

      # effective (= nb of samples by host)
      eff <- length(samp)

      out[[h]] <- data.frame(
        taxon = taxa_all,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      out[[h]][[paste0(h, "_abundance_", suffix)]]   <- as.numeric(med_ab)
      out[[h]][[paste0(h, "_prevalence_", suffix)]]  <- as.numeric(prev)
      out[[h]][[paste0(h, "_effectif_", suffix)]]    <- eff
    }

    Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "taxon", all = TRUE), out)
  }
  print("stat calculated")

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Build finale table
  # --------------------------------------------------
  tab_filtered <- host_stats(hilu.filtered.species, "filtered")
  tab_final <- merge(core_df, tab_filtered, by = "taxon", all.x = TRUE)

  if (has_lonely) {
    tab_lonely <- host_stats(hilu.lonely.species, "lonely")
    tab_final <- merge(tab_final, tab_lonely, by = "taxon", all.x = TRUE)
  }

  tab_final <- tab_final[order(tab_final$core, tab_final$taxon), , drop = FALSE]
  print("table created")

  list(
    prefix = prefix,
    hilu.filtered.species = hilu.filtered.species,
    hilu.lonely.species = if (has_lonely) hilu.lonely.species else NULL,
    Core_invasive_clean = Core_invasive_clean,
    Core_native_clean = Core_native_clean,
    table = tab_final
  )
}





analyse_filtered_16s <- process_filtered(prefix = "16s",
physeq_file = "Clean_phyloseq_16S.rds",
physeq_filtered = "filtered_out_16S.rds",
invasive_core = "otus_invasive_only_16S.rds",
native_core = "otus_native_only_16S.rds")


analyse_filtered_ITS <- process_filtered(prefix="OL4",
physeq_file = "Clean_phyloseq_OL4.rds",
physeq_filtered = "filtered_out_OL4.rds",
invasive_core = "otus_invasive_only_OL4.rds",
native_core = "otus_native_only_OL4.rds")



writexl::write_xlsx(analyse_filtered_16s$table, "analyse_filtered_16S.xlsx")
writexl::write_xlsx(analyse_filtered_ITS$table, "analyse_filtered_ITS.xlsx")

################################################## filtered core vs Unfiltered core ################################################

core_filteredVScore <- function(prefix, physeq_file, physeq_filtered, invasive_core, native_core) {

  # import
  hilu <- readRDS(physeq_file)               # cleaned pool
  hilu.filtered <- readRDS(physeq_filtered)  # filtered pool
  print("import success")

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Keep only HostSpecies presents in both version
  # --------------------------------------------------
  sd_clean <- as.data.frame(sample_data(hilu))
  sd_filt  <- as.data.frame(sample_data(hilu.filtered))

  hosts_clean <- unique(as.character(sd_clean$HostSpecies))
  hosts_filt  <- unique(as.character(sd_filt$HostSpecies))
  common_hosts <- intersect(hosts_clean, hosts_filt)

  keep_clean <- rownames(sd_clean)[as.character(sd_clean$HostSpecies) %in% common_hosts]
  keep_filt  <- rownames(sd_filt )[as.character(sd_filt $HostSpecies) %in% common_hosts]

  hilu <- prune_samples(keep_clean, hilu)
  hilu.filtered <- prune_samples(keep_filt, hilu.filtered)

  print(paste0("common hosts kept: ", length(common_hosts)))

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # HostSpecies with n = 1
  # --------------------------------------------------
  sd <- as.data.frame(sample_data(hilu))

  host_counts <- table(sd$HostSpecies)
  lonely_hosts <- names(host_counts[host_counts == 1])
  lonely_samples <- rownames(sd)[sd$HostSpecies %in% lonely_hosts]

  if (length(lonely_samples) == 0) {
    has_lonely <- FALSE
    hilu.lonely <- NULL
    print("no lonely host -> skipping hilu.lonely")
  } else {
    hilu.lonely <- prune_samples(lonely_samples, hilu)
    has_lonely <- nsamples(hilu.lonely) > 0
    print("hilu.lonely created")
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # helper: clean names
  # --------------------------------------------------
  clean_final_number <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- trimws(x)
    x[x == "" | is.na(x)] <- "Unassigned"
    x
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # OTU -> Species 
  # --------------------------------------------------
  otu_to_species <- function(phy) {

    otu <- as(otu_table(phy), "matrix")
    if (!taxa_are_rows(phy)) otu <- t(otu)
    if (nrow(otu) == 0 || ncol(otu) == 0) return(NULL)

    tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))

    otu_ids <- rownames(otu)
    species_ordered <- tax[otu_ids, "Species"]

    species_ordered <- number_species_labels(species_ordered)
    tax[otu_ids, "Species"] <- species_ordered

    otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu)
    otu_df$Species <- species_ordered

    species_list <- unique(otu_df$Species)

    summed_list <- lapply(species_list, function(sp) {
      subm <- otu_df[otu_df$Species == sp, -ncol(otu_df), drop = FALSE]
      colSums(subm)
    })
    names(summed_list) <- species_list

    otu_species_mat <- do.call(rbind, summed_list)
    otu_species_mat <- as.matrix(otu_species_mat)

    if (nrow(otu_species_mat) == 0 || ncol(otu_species_mat) == 0) {
      stop(prefix, " : otu_to_species produit une matrice vide")
    }

    rownames(otu_species_mat) <- names(summed_list)
    otu_new <- otu_table(otu_species_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

    tax_species <- tax
    tax_species$..old <- rownames(tax_species)
    tax_species$Species <- as.character(tax_species$Species)

    tax_species_df <- tax_species[!duplicated(tax_species$Species), , drop = FALSE]
    rownames(tax_species_df) <- tax_species_df$Species
    tax_species_df$..old <- NULL

    tax_species_df <- tax_species_df[taxa_names(otu_new), , drop = FALSE]
    tax_new <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_species_df))

    phyloseq(otu_new, sample_data(phy), tax_new)
  }
  print("OTU to species done")

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # helper: merge taxa which are identical after clean_final_number
  # --------------------------------------------------
  collapse_by_clean_name <- function(phy) {

    if (is.null(phy)) return(NULL)

    otu <- as(otu_table(phy), "matrix")
    if (!taxa_are_rows(phy)) otu <- t(otu)
    if (nrow(otu) == 0 || ncol(otu) == 0) return(NULL)

    old_taxa <- rownames(otu)
    new_taxa <- clean_final_number(old_taxa)

    otu_collapsed <- rowsum(otu, group = new_taxa, reorder = FALSE)

    if (is.null(dim(otu_collapsed))) {
      otu_collapsed <- matrix(
        otu_collapsed,
        nrow = 1,
        dimnames = list(unique(new_taxa), colnames(otu))
      )
    } else {
      otu_collapsed <- as.matrix(otu_collapsed)
      colnames(otu_collapsed) <- colnames(otu)
    }

    otu_new <- otu_table(otu_collapsed, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

    tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))
    tax$..old <- rownames(tax)
    tax$..clean <- clean_final_number(tax$..old)

    tax_new_df <- tax[!duplicated(tax$..clean), , drop = FALSE]
    rownames(tax_new_df) <- tax_new_df$..clean
    tax_new_df$..old <- NULL
    tax_new_df$..clean <- NULL

    tax_new_df <- tax_new_df[taxa_names(otu_new), , drop = FALSE]
    tax_new <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_new_df))

    phyloseq(otu_new, sample_data(phy), tax_new)
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Species level for CLEAN + FILTERED (+ LONELY)
  # --------------------------------------------------
  hilu.clean.species <- collapse_by_clean_name(otu_to_species(hilu))
  if (is.null(hilu.clean.species)) stop(prefix, " : hilu (clean) donne 0 taxa ou 0 samples après transformation.")

  hilu.filtered.species <- collapse_by_clean_name(otu_to_species(hilu.filtered))
  if (is.null(hilu.filtered.species)) stop(prefix, " : hilu.filtered donne 0 taxa ou 0 samples après transformation.")

  if (has_lonely) {
    hilu.lonely.species <- collapse_by_clean_name(otu_to_species(hilu.lonely))
  }
  print("species objects created")

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # add origin and merged CLEAN + FILTERED
  # --------------------------------------------------
  sd_c <- as.data.frame(sample_data(hilu.clean.species))
  sd_f <- as.data.frame(sample_data(hilu.filtered.species))

  sd_c$Origin <- "cleaned"
  sd_f$Origin <- "filtered"

  sample_data(hilu.clean.species) <- sample_data(sd_c)
  sample_data(hilu.filtered.species) <- sample_data(sd_f)

  merged.species <- merge_phyloseq(hilu.clean.species, hilu.filtered.species)
  print("merged phyloseq created (cleaned + filtered)")

  # ============================================================
  # Core microbiome
  # ============================================================
  if (!requireNamespace("microbiome", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Le package 'microbiome' est requis.")
  if (!requireNamespace("RColorBrewer", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Le package 'RColorBrewer' est requis.")
  if (!requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Le package 'patchwork' est requis.")
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Le package 'ggplot2' est requis.")

  prevalences <- seq(.05, 1, .05)
  detections  <- 10^seq(log10(1e-3), log10(.2), length = 20)

  merged.comp <- microbiome::transform(merged.species, "compositional")

  meta_m <- as.data.frame(sample_data(merged.comp))
  meta_m$HostSpecies <- as.character(meta_m$HostSpecies)
  meta_m$Origin      <- as.character(meta_m$Origin)

  if ("Category" %in% colnames(meta_m)) {
    host_order_df <- unique(meta_m[, c("HostSpecies", "Category")])
    host_order_df$Category <- factor(host_order_df$Category, levels = c("Invasive", "Native"))
    host_order_df <- host_order_df[order(host_order_df$Category, host_order_df$HostSpecies), , drop = FALSE]
    ordered_HostSpecies <- as.character(host_order_df$HostSpecies)
  } else {
    ordered_HostSpecies <- sort(unique(meta_m$HostSpecies))
  }

  origin_levels <- c("cleaned", "filtered")
  origin_levels <- origin_levels[origin_levels %in% unique(meta_m$Origin)]

  subset_host_origin <- function(phy, host, org) {
    meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(phy))
    keep <- rownames(meta)[as.character(meta$HostSpecies) == host &
                             as.character(meta$Origin) == org]
    prune_samples(keep, phy)
  }

  # labels X rounded at 4 decimals
  format_x_4dp <- function(x) {
    xv <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
    ifelse(is.na(xv), as.character(x), formatC(xv, format = "f", digits = 4))
  }

  # --- IMPORTANT: drop taxa with Prevalence==0 everywhere in plot_core data---
  drop_all_zero_prevalence_from_plot <- function(p) {
    d <- p$data
    if (is.null(d) || !is.data.frame(d) || nrow(d) == 0) return(p)

    taxa_col <- intersect(c("OTU", "Taxa", "taxa", "Taxon", "taxon"), colnames(d))[1]
    prev_col <- intersect(c("Prevalence", "prevalence"), colnames(d))[1]

    # if unexpected structure -> don't touch
    if (is.na(taxa_col) || is.na(prev_col)) return(p)

    taxa_chr <- as.character(d[[taxa_col]])
    prev_num <- d[[prev_col]]

    max_prev <- tapply(prev_num, taxa_chr, max, na.rm = TRUE)
    keep_taxa <- names(max_prev)[max_prev > 0]

    d2 <- d[taxa_chr %in% keep_taxa, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(d2) == 0) return(NULL)

    # keep origine order
    levs <- unique(taxa_chr)
    levs_keep <- levs[levs %in% keep_taxa]
    d2[[taxa_col]] <- factor(as.character(d2[[taxa_col]]), levels = levs_keep)

    p$data <- d2
    p + ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(drop = TRUE)
  }

  # fallback heatmap nsamples==1 : keep only the detected 
  plot_single_sample_presence <- function(phy_sub, title_text, detection = 0.001) {
    otu <- as(otu_table(phy_sub), "matrix")
    if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_sub)) otu <- t(otu)
    if (ncol(otu) != 1) stop("plot_single_sample_presence attend exactement 1 sample.")

    prev01 <- as.numeric(otu[, 1] >= detection)
    keep <- rownames(otu)[prev01 > 0]
    if (length(keep) == 0) return(NULL)

    df <- data.frame(
      OTU = factor(keep, levels = rev(keep)),
      Detection = factor(as.character(detection), levels = as.character(detection)),
      Prevalence = 1
    )

    ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = Detection, y = OTU, fill = Prevalence)) +
      ggplot2::geom_tile() +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
        colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "Spectral")),
        limits = c(0, 1),
        breaks = c(0, 1),
        guide = "none"
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = format_x_4dp) +
      ggplot2::labs(title = title_text) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.text.y  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
        axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.text.x  = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
      )
  }

  core_otus_by_group <- list()
  core_otus_all <- character(0)
  groups_used <- character(0)

  # 1) calculate core by (HostSpecies x Origin)
  for (host in ordered_HostSpecies) {
    for (org in origin_levels) {

      phy_sub <- subset_host_origin(merged.comp, host, org)
      n_s <- nsamples(phy_sub)

      if (n_s >= 1) {
        if (n_s > 1) {
          core_phy <- microbiome::core(phy_sub, detection = 0.001, prevalence = 0.5)
          otus <- taxa_names(core_phy)
        } else {
          otu <- as(otu_table(phy_sub), "matrix")
          if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_sub)) otu <- t(otu)
          otus <- rownames(otu)[otu[, 1] >= 0.001]
        }

        key <- paste(host, org, sep = " | ")
        core_otus_by_group[[key]] <- otus
        groups_used <- c(groups_used, key)

        if (length(otus) > 0) core_otus_all <- union(core_otus_all, otus)
      }
    }
  }

  # 2) Heatmaps
  core_plots <- list()

  for (key in groups_used) {

    host <- strsplit(key, " \\| ")[[1]][1]
    org  <- strsplit(key, " \\| ")[[1]][2]

    phy_sub <- subset_host_origin(merged.comp, host, org)
    n_s <- nsamples(phy_sub)
    if (n_s == 0) next

    title_text <- paste0(host, " (", org, ")\n(", n_s, " pools)")
    otus <- core_otus_by_group[[key]]

    if (n_s > 1) {

      if (length(otus) > 0) {

        phy_plot <- prune_taxa(otus, phy_sub)

        title_text2 <- paste0(host, " (", org, ")\n(",
                              nsamples(phy_plot), " pools - ", ntaxa(phy_plot), " OTUs)")

        p <- microbiome::plot_core(
          phy_plot,
          plot.type      = "heatmap",
          prevalences    = prevalences,
          detections     = detections,
          min.prevalence = 0.5,
          colours        = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "Spectral"))
        ) +
          ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
            colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "Spectral")),
            limits  = c(0, 1),
            guide   = "none"
          ) +
          ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = format_x_4dp) +
          ggplot2::labs(title = title_text2) +
          ggplot2::theme(
            plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
            axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
            axis.text.y  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
            axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
            axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
            axis.text.x  = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
          )

        # >>> delting useless taxa (prevalence=0 partout)
        p2 <- drop_all_zero_prevalence_from_plot(p)

        if (is.null(p2)) {
          df0 <- data.frame(x = 1, y = 1, z = 0)
          p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df0, ggplot2::aes(x, y, fill = z)) +
            ggplot2::geom_tile() +
            ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(limits = c(0, 1), guide = "none") +
            ggplot2::labs(title = paste0(title_text, "\n(aucun OTU utile: prevalence=0 partout)")) +
            ggplot2::theme_void() +
            ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0.5))
        } else {
          p <- p2
        }

      } else {
        df0 <- data.frame(x = 1, y = 1, z = 0)
        p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df0, ggplot2::aes(x, y, fill = z)) +
          ggplot2::geom_tile() +
          ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(limits = c(0, 1), guide = "none") +
          ggplot2::labs(title = paste0(title_text, "\n(0 OTU core)")) +
          ggplot2::theme_void() +
          ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0.5))
      }

    } else {
      # nsamples == 1
      p <- plot_single_sample_presence(phy_sub, paste0(title_text, "\n(binary prevalence)"), detection = 0.001)

      if (is.null(p)) {
        df0 <- data.frame(x = 1, y = 1, z = 0)
        p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df0, ggplot2::aes(x, y, fill = z)) +
          ggplot2::geom_tile() +
          ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(limits = c(0, 1), guide = "none") +
          ggplot2::labs(title = paste0(title_text, "\n(aucun OTU >= 0.001)")) +
          ggplot2::theme_void() +
          ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0.5))
      }
    }

    core_plots[[key]] <- p
  }

  heatmap_combined <- NULL
  if (length(core_plots) == 0) {
    message(prefix, " : aucun groupe (HostSpecies x Origin) trouvé.")
  } else {
    ordered_groups <- c()
    for (host in ordered_HostSpecies) {
      for (org in origin_levels) {
        k <- paste(host, org, sep = " | ")
        if (k %in% names(core_plots)) ordered_groups <- c(ordered_groups, k)
      }
    }
    core_plots <- core_plots[ordered_groups]

    heatmap_combined <- patchwork::wrap_plots(core_plots, ncol = length(origin_levels))
    print(heatmap_combined)
  }

  return(list(
    prefix = prefix,
    common_hosts = common_hosts,
    merged.species = merged.species,
    merged.compositional = merged.comp,
    core_otus_by_group = core_otus_by_group,
    core_otus_all = core_otus_all,
    heatmap = heatmap_combined
  ))
}

################# import data as individual phyloseq 
make_phyloseq_from_files <- function(metadata_file,
                                     otu_file,
                                     tax_file,
                                     sep_otu = "\t",
                                     sep_tax = "\t") {

 
  otu_df <- read.delim(otu_file, sep = sep_otu, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE) #OTU_table
  otu_mat <- as.matrix(column_to_rownames(otu_df, var = colnames(otu_df)[1]))
  OTU <- otu_table(otu_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

  
  meta_df <- read.csv(metadata_file, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) #metadata
  meta_df <- meta_df[, -1]
  meta_mat <- meta_df
  meta_mat <- column_to_rownames(meta_mat, var = colnames(meta_mat)[1])


  samples_otu <- sample_names(OTU) # Harmonization
  samples_meta <- rownames(meta_mat)
  common_samples <- intersect(samples_otu, samples_meta)

  if (length(common_samples) == 0) {
    stop("Aucun échantillon en commun entre OTU table et metadata. Vérifie la colonne ID.")
  }

  meta_mat2 <- meta_mat[common_samples, , drop = FALSE] # filter and order metadata following OTU table order
  SD <- sample_data(meta_mat2)

  OTU2 <- prune_samples(common_samples, OTU) # Filter OTU table with common OTUs 


  tax_df <- read.delim(tax_file, sep = sep_tax, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE) #Tax_table
  tax_mat <- as.matrix(column_to_rownames(tax_df, var = colnames(tax_df)[1]))
  TAX <- tax_table(tax_mat)

  common_taxa <- intersect(taxa_names(OTU2), taxa_names(TAX)) # Harmonization taxa: Keep only taxa detected in OTU
  if (length(common_taxa) == 0) {
    stop("Aucun taxon en commun entre OTU table et tax table. Vérifie les IDs OTU/ASV.")
  }

  OTU3 <- prune_taxa(common_taxa, OTU2)
  TAX2 <- TAX[common_taxa, ]


  ps <- phyloseq(OTU3, SD, TAX2) # Build phyloseq

  # resume
  message("OK: ", nsamples(ps), " samples | ", ntaxa(ps), " taxa")
  return(ps)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Standardize Species for bibliographical comparison
# - NA / vide -> "Unassigned"
# - All variant of "Unknown" -> "Unclassified"
# - All variant of "Unknown species" -> "Unclassified species"
# ------------------------------------------------------------
standardize_species_labels_biblio <- function(species_vec) {
  species_vec <- as.character(species_vec)
  species_vec[is.na(species_vec) | trimws(species_vec) == ""] <- "Unassigned"
  species_vec <- trimws(species_vec)

  is_unknown_species <- function(x) {
    grepl("^unknown[ _.-]*species$", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  }

  is_unknown_only <- function(x) {
    grepl("^unknown$", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  }

  species_vec[is_unknown_species(species_vec)] <- "Unclassified species"
  species_vec[is_unknown_only(species_vec)]    <- "Unclassified"

  species_vec
}

#################### Rename OTUs before fusion


prefix_taxa <- function(ps, prefix) {  #Rename OTUs/ASVs in phyloseq by adding dataset initial
  stopifnot(inherits(ps, "phyloseq"))
  stopifnot(is.character(prefix), length(prefix) == 1)

  old_ids <- taxa_names(ps)
  new_ids <- paste0(prefix, old_ids)


  if (any(duplicated(new_ids))) { # Security against duplicate
    stop("Le préfixe crée des doublons d'OTU. Exemple: ", new_ids[which(duplicated(new_ids))[1]])
  }

  
  taxa_names(ps) <- new_ids # Rename everywhere in phyloseq

  
  if (!is.null(tax_table(ps, errorIfNULL = FALSE))) { # Check
    if (!setequal(taxa_names(ps), taxa_names(tax_table(ps)))) {
      
      warning("Les taxa de l'OTU table et de la tax_table ne correspondent pas parfaitement après renommage.")
    }
  }

  return(ps)
}

#Add class to the three biblio phyloseq
add_class <- function(ps) {
  sd <- sample_data(ps)
  hs <- as.character(sd$HostSpecies)

  sd$Class <- dplyr::case_when(
    hs %in% c("D.melanogaster", "D.simulans") ~ "melanogaster group",
    hs %in% c("D.sulfurigaster", "D.rubida", "D.pallidifrons") ~ "immigrans group",
    hs == "D.pseudoananassae" ~ "D. pseudoananassae",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_   # in case there is other species
  )
  sample_data(ps) <- sd
  ps
}

######### Representation

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) build "core set" and assign group
#------------------------------------------------------------
Common_core   <- trimws(Common_core)
Invasive_core <- trimws(Invasive_core)
Native_core   <- trimws(Native_core)
Other_core    <- trimws(Other_core)

core_taxa <- unique(c(Common_core, Invasive_core, Native_core, Other_core))

core_df <- tibble::tibble(OTU = core_taxa) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = dplyr::case_when(
    OTU %in% Common_core   ~ "Common",
    OTU %in% Native_core   ~ "Native",
    OTU %in% Invasive_core ~ "Invasive",
    OTU %in% Other_core    ~ "Other",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Common", "Native", "Invasive", "Other")))

group_colors <- c(
  "Common"   = "#556B2F",
  "Invasive" = "#882255",
  "Native"   = "#0000CD",
  "Other"    = "black"
)

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 1bis) Standardize Species and agglomerate at species level
#------------------------------------------------------------
tax_all <- as.data.frame(phyloseq::tax_table(hilu.all))
tax_all$Species <- standardize_species_labels_biblio(tax_all$Species)
phyloseq::tax_table(hilu.all) <- phyloseq::tax_table(as.matrix(tax_all))

hilu.sp <- phyloseq::tax_glom(hilu.all, taxrank = "Species", NArm = FALSE)

tax <- as.data.frame(phyloseq::tax_table(hilu.sp))
sp_names <- as.character(tax$Species)
sp_names <- standardize_species_labels_biblio(sp_names)
sp_names[is.na(sp_names) | sp_names == ""] <- paste0(
  "Unclassified_Species_",
  seq_len(sum(is.na(sp_names) | sp_names == ""))
)
sp_names <- make.unique(sp_names)
phyloseq::taxa_names(hilu.sp) <- sp_names

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Relative Abundance + format long
#------------------------------------------------------------
ps_rel <- phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(hilu.sp, function(x) x / sum(x))

# facets order
locclass_order <- c(
  "French Guiana - Invasive",
  "Europe - melanogaster group",
  "USA - melanogaster group",
  "Australia - D. pseudoananassae",
  "Australia - immigrans group",
  "French Guiana - willistoni group",
  "French Guiana - D. sturtevanti"
)

df_long <- phyloseq::psmelt(ps_rel) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Locality = as.character(Locality),

    # sample_data class
    Class    = as.character(sample_Class),

    LocClass = paste(Locality, Class, sep = " - "),
    LocClass = factor(LocClass, levels = locclass_order)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(OTU %in% core_taxa)

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) abundance & prevalence thresholds 
#------------------------------------------------------------
t_max <- 0.05
n_steps <- 60
thresholds <- seq(0, t_max, length.out = n_steps)

prev_df <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::select(LocClass, OTU, Sample, Abundance) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(LocClass, OTU) %>%
  tidyr::nest() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prev_tbl = purrr::map(data, ~{
    a <- .x$Abundance
    tibble::tibble(
      thresh = thresholds,
      prevalence = vapply(thresholds, function(t) mean(a >= t, na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
    )
  })) %>%
  dplyr::select(-data) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(prev_tbl) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Identify line with prevalence = 0 for the minimal abundance:

grey_rows <- prev_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(thresh == 0) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    LocClass,
    OTU,
    absent_all = prevalence == 0
  )

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) global OTUs Order 
#------------------------------------------------------------
mean_global <- df_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(OTU) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_abund_global = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

otu_map <- core_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(mean_global, by = "OTU") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mean_abund_global = ifelse(is.na(mean_abund_global), 0, mean_abund_global)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(group, dplyr::desc(mean_abund_global)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    otu_label = sprintf(
      "<span style='color:%s'>%s</span>",
      group_colors[as.character(group)], OTU
    )
  )

y_levels <- otu_map$otu_label

prev_df <- prev_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(otu_map %>% dplyr::select(OTU, group, otu_label), by = "OTU") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(OTU_ord = factor(otu_label, levels = y_levels))

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Tiles
#------------------------------------------------------------
prev_df <- prev_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(grey_rows, by = c("LocClass", "OTU")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(absent_all = ifelse(is.na(absent_all), FALSE, absent_all)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(LocClass, OTU) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(thresh, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x0 = thresh,
    x1 = dplyr::lead(thresh)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(x1)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x_mid = (x0 + x1) / 2,
    x_w   = (x1 - x0)
  )

# grey tiles if taxa abscente evrywhere
grey_tiles <- prev_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(absent_all, x1 > 0.001) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x0_plot  = pmax(x0, 0.001),
    x1_plot  = x1,
    x_mid    = (x0_plot + x1_plot) / 2,
    x_w      = (x1_plot - x0_plot)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(x_w > 0)

# colored tiles
color_tiles <- prev_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!absent_all, x1 > 0.001) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x0_plot  = pmax(x0, 0.001),
    x1_plot  = x1,
    x_mid    = (x0_plot + x1_plot) / 2,
    x_w      = (x1_plot - x0_plot)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(x_w > 0)

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Plot
#------------------------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = grey_tiles,
    aes(x = x_mid, y = OTU_ord, width = x_w),
    height = 0.75,
    fill = "grey85"
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = color_tiles,
    aes(x = x_mid, y = OTU_ord, fill = prevalence, width = x_w),
    height = 0.75
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ LocClass,
    nrow = 1,
    labeller = ggplot2::labeller(
      LocClass = function(x) gsub(" - ", "\n", x)
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.001, t_max),
    breaks = seq(0.001, t_max, length.out = 6),
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.0001, trim = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#5B8DB8", "#D9EF8B", "#FEE08B", "#E9B44C", "#D32F2F"),
    values  = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
    limits  = c(0, 1),
    breaks  = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
    labels  = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01, trim = TRUE)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Abondance threshold",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Prévalence"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14),
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 13),
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.05, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5.5, r = 5.5, b = 5.5, l = 55)
  )

ggsave("core_biblio.pdf", plot = p, device = "pdf", width = 18, height = 10, units = "in")
